text:
April 26, 2018 Teradyne, Inc. (NYSE:TER) are down $5, or 12%,warned second-quarter revenue will miss expectations
Shares of semiconductor testing-equipment maker Teradyne, Inc. (NYSE:TER) are down $5, or 12%, and were down as much as $36.50 a little while ago, after the company this afternoon warned second-quarter revenue will miss expectations as demand for gear to test mobile devices dropped off.
It’s yet another bad data point for a stock market that has been wary of the smartphone industry for months now. Just yesterday, Mizuho cut its outlook for wireless-chip maker Skyworks Solutions (SWKS), on worries about Apple’s (AAPL) prospects for the iPhone.
